title: NRE, NRO and FCNR concepts
overview: NRE, NRO and FCNR are account or deposit categories used in Indian non-resident banking, with different purposes and currency features. Eligibility, permitted credits, taxation and repatriation depend on applicable rules and circumstances.
procedure: The fictional bank provides a product-comparison review through a demo agent. This assistant explains the categories at a high level but does not determine residency, invent regulatory limits or give personalized tax or remittance advice.

title: International transfers and SWIFT
overview: Cross-border transfers can involve sending, intermediary and receiving institutions, exchange conversion and compliance checks. A SWIFT identifier helps identify an institution; it does not itself establish the correct beneficiary account or guarantee final credit.
procedure: For a synthetic enquiry, specify the intended currency and general destination without real account details. A demo agent explains the required review; rates, fees, documentation and restrictions must come from current configured or authoritative terms, never an invented quote.
